question: Estimate the songs streamed daily on Spotify India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total streams across free + premium users? Yes.
Stream defined as a song played for >30 seconds? Yes (industry standard).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: DAU × songs per session × sessions per day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average listening time per DAU: ~45-60 minutes.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: DAU/MAU ratio for music streaming (high stickiness)

calculationFlow: DAU/MAU ratio for music streaming (high stickiness): ~50% = ~28M DAU.
